changeManifest.note: 106 effective lines measured (eslint max-lines, skipBlankLines+skipComments); 75 Tier-1 rows + 10 Tier-2 rows. Also declares GENERATION_TIER2, GENERATION_CHANNELS, GENERATION_BLIND_HALVES, GENERATION_CENSUS_ROWS, tier1For, tier2For. NO PRODUCTION IMPORTER.

The static arms: A2 totality against getStepMeta() in both directions, A3s the class derivation, A8s Tier 2's static half plus the registerStep-aware resolver and its guard-the-guard. 1 describe, 3 it.

The census by execution: A1 the controls, A3 the classification, A4 onRecord, A5 the mint channel, A6 the hash channel, A7 the corpus ceiling, A8e Tier 2's execution half. 1 describe, 5 it. Holds both vi.mock factories.

The instrumentation. A PLAIN .js helper, never a .test.js: importing a symbol from a .test.js re-registers that file's suites in every importer (the dormancyOracle incident). Registers no describe and no it, so it does not enter the lighting census denominator.

EM-PREAMBLE §P2.2 — mandatory for a new tests/lint/ file. Appended SURGICALLY beside its tests/lint/ siblings; the manifest is never re-serialised whole. kind: 'rationale' with a kindNote, following tests/lint/chooserTotality.walker.test.js's own row: the guard-the-guard controls are inside the file and execute on every run, and a sweep plant is a two-file edit whose second path this manifest does not reserve.

acceptanceCases: A1 — THE INSTRUMENT'S OWN CONTROL, the FIRST arm, and a STOP if it reds: with both mocks installed, on the control row total mints is 35-36 with via fork >= 31 (a total of 4 is the signature of a mock that did not reach the generator graph), direct mints = 4, 0 foreign-prefix seeds; the golden hash of that row is unchanged (b77b5909009112855bad4dacf881847d06e43385f64a15f4b528e0d30c91c3ce) and a stride sweep of >=25 rows moves 0; the population step draws > 0 unpinned (315) and exactly 0 under full pins, the pinned run reproducing the record; export parity holds for both mocked modules; src/kernel/prng.js:84 reads the fork derivation the re-implementation rests on. If this arm reds the lane writes the STOP with the numbers it saw and stops; it does NOT touch vite.config.js, a setupFiles entry or any shared vitest config.

A2 — TOTALITY BY CONSTRUCTION: GENERATION_TIER1's (step, key) set equals getStepMeta()'s in both directions; 75 rows; 57 via 'provides' + 18 via 'mutates'; the order is getStepOrder()'s; anti-vacuity floor (pairs > 70) asserted before any equality.

A3s — EVERY DERIVED FIELD IS DERIVED, NOT AUTHORED: for all 75 rows class follows the three rules from stepDraws/keyMoves; onRecordClass follows the four rules from the onRecord counts and onRecord.absent + .same + .transformed === rows on every row; every rows === GENERATION_CENSUS_ROWS; recordPath === null iff onRecordClass === 'absent' and is a non-empty string otherwise; every array, row and onRecord object is frozen; counts are 28 drawn, 1 label (generatePower|powerIntent), 46 pure, and absent 19, same 35, transformed 15, varies 6.

A3 — THE CLASSIFICATION, RE-EXECUTED: the 63-row corpus is built by the declared rule (42 grid + 21 tail); a fresh run of all 22 perturbations reproduces every row's stepDraws and keyMoves; 13 steps draw; a mismatch PRINTS the fresh literal and FAILS, never writes. Timeout 180000 ms (measured 25426 ms).

A4 — onRecord, RE-EXECUTED OVER THE WHOLE SAMPLE: over all 63 rows every row's onRecord COUNTS and recordPath equal the literal by the declared ladder (step 3 admits objects and arrays only); the six varies rows come out varies with those exact counts; a row whose non-absent recordPath is NOT unanimous across the corpus MUST be varies, otherwise the arm reds and prints both paths; a mismatch PRINTS the fresh literal and FAILS.

A5 — THE MINT CHANNEL: 4 DIRECT mints on the probe row; every seed prefixed by the run's root seed (0 foreign); the seed <root>::generatePower::power-structure minted 4 times with vias [fork, direct, direct, direct]; viaFork equals 22 step forks plus the sub-forks the proxy saw; total >= 35. The DIRECT count is the assertion; total mints and pickVariant counts are row-dependent and recorded, not pinned.

A6 — THE HASH CHANNEL: on the probe row pickVariant makes 96 calls, every pool > 1, every seed non-falsy, 96 distinct seeds; fnv1a32 external calls = 6; the two censuses are disjoint; the three DISPLAY-NAME-keyed sites are named as observed data (EM-P1b's class, nothing asserted about their cure).

A7 — THE CORPUS CEILING: under settType:'random', culture:'random_culture' and _randomizePriorities:true, over 24 seeds each, tier, townPlus, culture, magicLevel and priorityMagicEffective each move in at least one seed while the register classes them pure. The arm asserts > 0, never a ratio; the observed count is recorded in the failure message.

A8 — TIER 2, four arms plus the anchored negative: every outputKey resolves on a generated record (rows 1-4 and 6-10 at 42/42, npcs[].status at 18/42 so its floor is > 0); every (step, key) exists in Tier 1 and forkId === step; origin equals the holding-step perturbation (five rows computed); every module#symbol is declared exactly once by the registerStep-aware resolver, with its guard-the-guard (22/22 vs the model's 0/22, pickFirst = 1, three ghost negatives, two nonexistent symbols at 0); no row carries a producer or an editable field; powerStructure.seats[].holder is asserted absent via expectAbsentWithAnchor anchored on powerStructure.governingName.

chairRulingsCarried.Q-1: 28 drawn / 1 label / 46 pure. Design §21.5.1's '29 drawn, 46 pure' was the recon's pre-ruling count; the chair corrects the ledger.
chairRulingsCarried.Q-2: If the mock does not take, the build lane STOPS. The census's FIRST arm is the instrument's own control; the shared-config fallback (vite.config.js, setupFiles) is a CHAIR ACT, never a packet step.
chairRulingsCarried.Q-3: recordPath STAYS, contracted: the landing path for same/transformed (dotted from `record`, nested and renamed landings spelled in full), null for absent, never ''.
chairRulingsCarried.Q-4: producer is STRUCK. EM-A1's declarations already name each field's writer; the capability EM-A1 asked for is the resolver (§6.6), not a column.
chairRulingsCarried.Q-5: No probe row. onRecord carries per-row COUNTS over the 63-row sample plus a derived label that is 'varies' when not unanimous.
chairRulingsCarried.Q-6: CARRY BOTH COMPARANDS. Each Tier-1 row holds onRecord {absent,same,transformed} + onRecordClass (the key's FINAL value vs the record) AND producedOnRecord {absent,same,transformed} + producedOnRecordClass (the POST-STEP value vs the record). recordPath is defined against the FINAL comparand. MEASURED: over 63 corpus rows x 75 register rows, 0 rows where the post-step value lands at a different path than the final one, so NO producedPath field is carried and A4 re-measures that zero. The two classes disagree on 18 of 75 rows.
chairRulingsCarried.Q-7: ACCEPTED. The value-hash search admits objects and arrays only: the byte floor was the defect (a 12-byte string passes it), the type gate is the fix. Recorded in the evidence with the before/after for resolveConfig|tradeRoute (varies 58/5 -> absent 63/63) so the next reader does not re-find it.
